security_audit.summary: Most flags are Markdown delimiters, ordinary authentication references, provider links, or an entropy heuristic triggered by readable multilingual text. The CLI example executes an unpinned npm package with automatic confirmation and inherited environment access, creating a supply-chain risk. No evidence found of credential exfiltration, destructive actions, or prompt injection in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The CLI example downloads and executes socialdatax-skills@latest with npx -y while the API key is available in the environment.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and lock dependencies with integrity checks. Require approval before initial execution and restrict the runtime environment to necessary credentials.

content.user_title: Analyze Weibo Topics with Traceable Search Samples
content.value_statement: Weibo topic planning requires relevant examples and evidence that can be checked. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and organizes returned samples into content angles.
actual_capabilities: Search Weibo by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or the corresponding weibo_search_posts MCP tool.
Limit searches by page count or result count and continue with returned pagination tokens.
Organize relevant samples into content angles and follow-up research questions.
Preserve returned post IDs, links, author details, engagement metrics, and publication times for traceability.
Separate visible evidence from interpretation and label incomplete results during recovery.
limitations: Requires a configured SocialDataX API key and sufficient provider balance.
The direct CLI requires Node.js, npm, network access, and permission to execute an external package.
Search results are samples, not an exhaustive Weibo dataset; the search command does not support --all.
The workflow is read-only and does not log in, publish posts, like content, comment, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan editorial topics
use_cases.description: Search a focused theme and organize relevant posts into evidence-backed content directions.

use_cases.title: Compare competitor messaging
use_cases.description: Search competing brand keywords and compare visible themes, engagement signals, and gaps within the returned samples.

use_cases.title: Develop creator angles
use_cases.description: Collect relevant examples, identify possible angles, and select follow-up questions for a narrower search.

prompt_templates.title: Find an initial sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Weibo for [keyword] using one page. Summarize relevant samples and preserve available links or post IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Organize content angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [topic] with a maximum of 20 results. Group relevant samples into content angles and distinguish evidence from interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare competing brands
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [brand A] and [brand B], one page each. Compare sampled content themes and available engagement metrics, preserving sources and limitations.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an incomplete search
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume the partial [keyword] search using its unchanged continuation token. Deduct collected pages and items from original limits, preserve prior samples, and report gaps.

output_examples.input: Search one page for commuter cycling and suggest content angles.
output: Illustrative format, not live search results.
Samples: returned titles, author details, and source links or post IDs.
Angles: candidate themes linked to supporting samples, with interpretation labeled separately.
Follow-up: refine the query by audience or commuting context.

output_examples.input: Continue a partially completed brand search without exceeding the original limits.
output: Illustrative recovery format, not an executed request.
Status: partial results retained with the reported error.
Continuation: use the unchanged nonempty token and remaining page and item allowances.
Coverage: identify unresolved gaps; do not treat an empty token as proof of completion.

best_practices: Start with one focused page and set explicit page or item limits before expanding research.
Preserve source identifiers and separate observed facts from your interpretation.
Approve and review the external CLI package before execution; keep the API key out of prompts and reports.
anti_patterns: Treating a small search sample as comprehensive evidence of Weibo-wide trends.
Changing continuation tokens or restarting partial searches without adjusting original collection limits.
Repeatedly retrying balance errors or presenting invented posts and engagement figures as retrieved evidence.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: Provide a keyword or topic direction. A focused query makes the first sample easier to evaluate.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX account?
faq.answer: You need a SocialDataX API key configured as SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sufficient provider balance.

faq.question: Does it require an MCP server?
faq.answer: No. An agent with shell access can use the direct CLI. The instructions also name the corresponding weibo_search_posts MCP tool.

faq.question: Can it publish or interact with posts?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow only searches and analyzes results; it does not log in, post, like, comment, or modify accounts.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every matching post?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable exhaustive boundary. Use page and item limits, and do not interpret an empty page as completion.

faq.question: What happens when a search fails?
faq.answer: Retain partial results and report the error. Resume with an unchanged nonempty continuation token when available, respecting remaining limits.
